FINAL SQL:
SELECT dp.degree_program_id, dp.degree_summary_name
FROM Degree_Programs dp
JOIN (
    SELECT degree_program_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM Student_Enrolment
    GROUP BY degree_program_id
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS top ON dp.degree_program_id = top.degree_program_id;
